In Psalm 77:8 it voices the psalmist's anguished question about whether God's steadfast love has permanently ceased. German glosses ('zu Ende ist,' 'hat kommen zu ein enden') vividly capture the finality, while Spanish '¿Acaso cesó?' preserves the interrogative force of the psalm."
